name: T-38 Talon
summary: Supersonic twin-jet advanced trainer used for USAF pilot training and as a companion trainer, being replaced by the T-7A Red Hawk.

wings: No leading-edge root extensions and no wingtip missile rails
engines: Two small engines with exhausts close together at the tail
Small side intakes just ahead of the wing root
fuselage: Very slim, needle-nosed fuselage with a pinched 'coke bottle' waist
Tandem two-seat cockpit under a long canopy, rear seat raised
Usually white or, with bomber and fighter companion units, gloss black
tail: All-moving horizontal tail set low on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Slim needle-nosed jet with two seats under a long canopy
Waisted fuselage with small side intakes and no wing-root extensions
Small thin low wings with bare wingtips

confusedWith.howToTell: The T-38 is a slim two-seater with no wing-root extensions or wingtip rails; the F-5 has LERX, wingtip missile rails and usually a single seat in camouflage.
The T-38 has two engines and a needle nose on a waisted body; the T-45 has one engine, a blunter nose and a drooping tailplane.
The T-33 is a straight-wing, single-engine jet with big tip tanks and a very long canopy; the T-38 has swept wings, twin engines and a sleek pointed nose.
